name: Lizzear
body:
The lizzear are a strong reptilian-looking species with scaly skin mixed with fur, long heads, and beady eyes.

They are commonly found in major civilized areas working trades or working as mercenaries or guards.

Lizzear Ancestral Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Lizzears are capable of great brute force, and claim highly capable senses, though they are rather lumbering. +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Dexterity:
Size: Lizzears are Medium creatures and thus receive no benefits or penalties due to their size.
Type: Surprisingly, lizzears are humanoid, with the lizzear subtype. They are mammals, after all.
Normal Speed: Lizzears have a movement speed of 30 feet.
Scaled Hide: Their bodies covered in scales, lizzears gain a +1 natural armor bonus to their armor class.
Furred and Scaled: Due to the mixing of coverings all over their bodies, lizzears gain a +2 racial bonus on any check or saving throw made against environmental factors of cold or heat.
Perceptive: Due to their great senses, lizzears gain a +2 bonus to all Perception checks.
Powerful Build: When determining your carrying capacity or the amount of weight a lizzear can lift or drag, they are treated as being one size category larger.
Well-Integrated: Despite their odd appearances and lumbering nature, the lizzears have adapted to society surprising well. They gain a +2 racial bonus to any one craft, perform, or profession skill.
Darkvision: Lizzears can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.
Scent: With their impressive noses, Lizzears gain the scent ability.
Thick-Throated, Long-Jawed: Despite how well they’ve managed to integrate themselves into society and how impressive both their strength and perceptive skills are, the odd shape of the lizzear’s vocal chords make casting spells difficult. When casting any spell with a verbal component, the lizzear is treated as having a 20% arcane spell failure chance. This spell failure chance applies even if the spell is divine. Additionally, this spell failure chance is added on top of any spell failure chance gained by wearing armor or through other means.
Languages: Lizzears begin play with both Common and the Lizzear language. Lizzears with high Intelligence may select any language (with the exception of druidic).
Alternate Ancestral Traits
Claws: Some lizzears develop strong claws at the expense of less armor. They receive two 1d3 claw attacks. These are primary natural attacks. This ability replaces scaled hide.
Lizzear Spellcaster: While they lack the aptitude for it, some lizzear are able to train themselves in the arcane arts. They gain the Silent Spell metamagic feat as a bonus feat. Additionally, they may cast a spell with the Silent Spell metamagic feat three times per day without raising the spell’s level. This feature replaces scent.
